731:t_002:47.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then, following their orders, I set out on an endless journey to find the $$スフィア$$s.」

731:t_002:48.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So in the end, you did whatever they told you.」

731:t_002:49.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No. I did it to strike them down with the $$スフィア$$s' power.」

731:t_002:50.en:
$$アサキム$$
「They thought they had me under mind control. But my black wings broke free of it.」

731:t_002:51.en:
$n
「Why were you working with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

731:t_002:52.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Though he was an $$御使い$$, I thought he was different from the others...」

731:t_002:53.en:
$$万丈$$
「According to $$サクリファイ$$, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was banished from the $$御使い$$s around the time $$至高神ソル$$ shattered into the $$スフィア$$s...」

731:t_002:54.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So the $$御使い$$s other than $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ were the ones who cursed $$アサキム$$.」

731:t_002:55.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But in the end, he too was only an $$御使い$$... I felt the same disappointment you felt in $$サクリファイ$$.」

731:t_002:56.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is why I seek the power to destroy every $$御使い$$... the $$スフィア$$s!」

731:t_003:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$シュロウガ$$s! And so many of them!」

731:t_003:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Creating this many isotopes is trivial for me as I am now.」

731:t_003:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is bad...! This is very bad!」

731:t_003:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those $$シュロウガ$$s are being controlled by $$黒の英知$$!」

731:t_003:6.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$黒の英知$$...! Like the $$スフィア$$s, it is a fragment of the $$太極$$ that brings knowledge and power to those who touch it...!」

731:t_003:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「How can he have so much of something like that?!」

731:t_003:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I found it while searching for the $$スフィア$$s.」

731:t_003:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「CHRONO H... The boundary of time... What the $$太極$$ reached at the end of eternity was despair...」

731:t_003:10.en:
$$アサキム$$
「They are fragments of $$至高神ソル$$, who ended his own life. I thought they would surely provide the power to strike down the $$御使い$$s.」

731:t_003:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He has a $$シュロウガ$$ force and $$黒の英知$$...!」

731:t_003:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「Watch out! Something else is coming!」

731:t_004:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Are they planning to wipe out both us and $$アサキム$$ here?!」

731:t_004:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I can sense... $$サクリファイ$$... She... must be nearby...」

731:t_004:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$哀しみのサクリファイ$$... So you intend to lend me your power to hide your own guilt...」

731:t_004:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like the two sides in black are cooperating.」

731:t_004:8.en:
$$ベック$$
「Tch! I knew nobody who likes black could be any good!」

731:t_004:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...I do not like this, $$サクリファイ$$. You offer me charity from on high like that?」

731:t_004:10.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then I shall teach you. This battle is a feast... Yes, the beginning of a feast of terror that will end your 120 million years.」

731:t_004:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「...We have no choice. We don't intend to die either!」

731:t_004:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll show $$サクリファイ$$ too...! I'll show her our battle... and what the things they have done have brought about!」

731:t_004:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「Our target is the $$シュロウガ$$ piloted by $$アサキム$$! Defeat him, and it all ends!」

731:t_004:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Be careful! Unlike our previous battle, he is serious this time!」

731:t_004:16.en:
$$桂$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$! We're counting on you to handle what comes next!」

731:t_004:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「I've done everything I can! As for the result, we'll leave it to...」

731:t_004:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「No... From here on, bringing victory within reach is up to you!」

731:t_004:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah...! I'm not about to start praying to gods at this point!」

731:t_004:21.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Let's make a miracle happen!」

731:t_004:22.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Let's make a miracle happen!」

731:t_004:23.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Yes... You really are wonderful.」

731:t_004:24.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アサキム$$! We've come this far, so we'll settle it by slugging it out!」

731:t_004:25.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll end the battle between you and us here!」

731:t_004:26.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No! This is where it begins!」

731:t_004:27.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now, sound the bell of battle! The feast of the end begins!!」
